_meta.blurb: Only orgs with a clear ownership signal. Most stay unset — silence is honest.

hellotickets.note: Engineers debate strategy in grooming and own product context.

tinybird.note: Deleted the PM layer; technical leads own product decisions.

dcycle.note: Engineers talk to customers; teams ship without CEO/sales gates.

getinvoice.note: Solo-founder maker loop — no classic product org.

automattic.note: Product designers absorb discovery and prioritization.

shopify.note: PMs own buyer-side surfaces — checkout, payments, post-purchase.

trucksters.note: Each PM owns a business-unit metric end-to-end.

inology.note: PM sits in pre-sales to refuse enterprise one-offs.

meta.note: PMMs sit inside product strategy with PMs.

factorial.note: Growth team owns the acquire→activate experiment loop.

webel.note: CPO + founders + product committee own priority; product squad ships.

spotify.note: Strategy re-centered at VP level after squad autonomy.

citibox.note: Product prioritizes B2B economics over end-user feature polish.

cobee.note: Product prioritizes employee pull so HR buys the platform.

landbot.note: Product + PMM sell time saved so non-engineers ship conversational automation.

tuio.note: CPO-led data craft — qualitative + spreadsheet now, instrument later.

waynabox.note: Design starts from the travel constraint and user job, not UI trends.

guruwalk.note: Founder culture of radical autonomy — mission swarms over hierarchy.

ontrack.note: Founders validated the empty-truck problem with a Telegram MVP before process.

clevergy.note: Co-founders (product, CTO, sales) own the white-label energy roadmap together.

bonilista.note: Founder-built community product — belonging over list broadcast.

ucademy.note: Business-driven education iteration before PM framework worship.
